card.name: Linking words before a technical term
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (of, that, with, known, contain, a comma) right before a specific scientific term such as a microbe, chemical or hormone name. Seen in science news and lab-test descriptions.

modes.label: Linking word before a substance
modes.description: A preposition or verb such as of, with, contain or produce comes just before a chemical or hormone name.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before a scientific name or abbreviation is about to appear.
